repairs.found: Session update recorded requested thinking but did not change effective Pi thinking.
repairs.changed: After Runtime ready, call select_thinking_level and verify effective model plus thinking receipt.

repairs.found: The file spool wrapper did not intercept ordinary business Tool fetches.
repairs.changed: Use a temporary capability-token-protected loopback Gateway.

repairs.found: A writable disposable database Session was labelled read_only, so the Agent refused authorized mutations.
repairs.changed: Use per_action and separate host-filesystem authority from scoped CSM Tool authority.

repairs.found: MCP isError:true results were counted as successful Tool calls.
repairs.changed: Record a failed ledger entry and return a structured ValueError.

repairs.found: Verifier exceptions could bypass unbind/delete and cleanup failure could still report completed.
repairs.changed: Use nested finally, explicit cleanup states, and invalidate the report on delete failure.

repairs.found: Public reports exposed verifier names and low-entropy expected-value hashes.
repairs.changed: Project only verifier index, pass state, and error type; keep SQL, names, and expected values Host-private.

repairs.found: A turn_failed run could count as task success when database verifiers happened to pass.
repairs.changed: Require turn_completed, no Runtime error, and all verifiers for task success.

repairs.found: Task-selected Tools could be misrepresented as free selection from the full catalog.
repairs.changed: Mark toolSelectionMode as task_selected_oracle and disclose selected Tool-name visibility.

repairs.found: Missing toolCallId validation allowed a mutation replay to execute twice.
repairs.changed: Require a non-empty ID; cache exact replays and fail closed on same-ID different-payload reuse.

repairs.found: The Validation loader parsed every task body, including Held-out.
repairs.changed: Check the filename universe first, then read only explicit IDs in the selected split.

repairs.found: Expected RuntimeError escaped the generic HTTP Server and disconnected the client.
repairs.changed: Convert expected EnterpriseOps Tool failures to structured ValueError responses.
